points.description: Names the reactor as the Completely Mixed Flow Reactor (CMFR), i.e. a completely mixed reactor with continuous flow (also acceptable: continuous stirred tank reactor, CSTR, as the same reactor).
points.partial_credit: Half credit (0.75) only if 'completely mixed' / 'fully mixed' reactor is given but 'flow' is omitted or the term is imprecise.

points.description: Gives the correct technical term without a wrong extra or contradictory reactor type (e.g. does not also name plug flow, batch, or arrested-flow reactor as the answer).

rubric.notes: Full marks only for 'Completely mixed flow reactor' (CMFR), or the exact equivalent CSTR. Vague answers such as 'mixing reactor', 'stirred reactor' or 'agitated tank' earn nothing on P1. Plug flow, batch or any other reactor named, or a wrong extra answer, scores 0.
